notes.path: d4 Nf6
notes.text: The King's Indian Defence. Black develops 1...Nf6 to control e4 and prepares ...g6 and ...Bg7 to pressure the centre from afar.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6
notes.text: Black stops White from pushing e5 and prepares to castle. Against 5.Nf3, Black castles with 5...O-O before striking in the centre.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O Be2
notes.text: The Classical Variation. Black strikes at the centre immediately with 6...e5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O Be2 e5 O-O
notes.text: Black develops 7...Nc6 to add pressure onto d4 and lure White into closing the centre with d5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O Be2 e5 O-O Nc6 d5
notes.text: White closes the centre and gains queenside space. Black retreats 8...Ne7 so the f-pawn can advance to f5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O Be2 e5 O-O Nc6 d5 Ne7 Ne1 Nd7 Nd3
notes.text: White heads to the queenside with Nd3 and c5. Black launches the kingside counterattack with 10...f5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O Be2 e5 d5
notes.text: The Petrosian System closes the centre before White castles. Black clamps down on the queenside with 7...a5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O Be2 e5 Be3
notes.text: White keeps the tension on d4 and develops the bishop. Black immediately attacks the e3 bishop with 7...Ng4.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Nf3 O-O g3
notes.text: White aims for a fianchetto set-up to guard d4. Black prepares ...e5 solidly with 6...Nbd7.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 g3 Bg7 Bg2 O-O Nf3 d6 O-O
notes.text: The Fianchetto Variation keeps White's kingside safe. Black plays 6...Nbd7 and ...e5 to claim central space.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 Be2 O-O Bg5
notes.text: The Averbakh Variation stops ...e5 for the moment. Black hits White's centre from the other side with 6...c5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 h3
notes.text: The Makogonov System stops ...Bg4 and prepares g4. Black castles calmly with 5...O-O.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f3
notes.text: The Saemisch Variation builds a rigid centre and aims for a kingside storm. Black castles 5...O-O before striking back.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f3 O-O Be3
notes.text: White guards d4 and prepares Qd2 and O-O-O. Black challenges the centre immediately with 6...e5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f3 O-O Be3 e5 d5
notes.text: White closes the centre to avoid trades. Black clears the f-pawn's path with 7...Nh5 and pushes ...f5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f3 O-O Be3 e5 Nge2
notes.text: White keeps the tension and develops the knight. Black trades 7...exd4 and breaks in the centre with ...c6.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f3 O-O Bg5
notes.text: White pins the knight in the Saemisch. Black strikes back at d4 immediately with 6...c5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f4
notes.text: The Four Pawns Attack grabs huge space, yet leaves White behind in development. Black castles 5...O-O and strikes with ...c5.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 Bg7 e4 d6 f4 O-O Nf3 c5 d5
notes.text: White keeps the pawns rolling forward. Black undermines the centre immediately with 7...e6.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Nf3 g6 Bf4
notes.text: The London System avoids c4 altogether. Black completes the fianchetto with ...Bg7, castles, and plays ...d6.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Bg5
notes.text: The Trompowsky Attack threatens Bxf6 to double Black's pawns. Black steps forward actively with 2...Ne4.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Bg5 Ne4 Bh4
notes.text: White tries to keep the bishop on the h4-d8 pin. Black immediately attacks the centre with 3...c5.
